title.description: Title of this report, preserving its version.

year.description: Year of this document version, not the first version of the study.

setting.description: Country, region, institutions, and relevant time period.

registration.description: Registration/PAP identifier, date, and timing relative to data.

data_availability.description: Reported data availability and exact access restrictions.

funding.description: Funding statement; absence of a located statement is not no funding.

design_type.description: Reported research design; reviewer classification must be marked.

estimand.description: Target quantity: population, contrast, weighting and time horizon.

target_population.description: Population to which the authors target their claim.

treatment.description: Assigned intervention or exposure, including dose and duration.

comparison.description: Reference condition and treatment contrast orientation.

assignment_unit.description: Unit assigned treatment, separate from observation unit.

assignment_procedure.description: Actual described allocation procedure and constraints.

assignment_pool.description: Pool within which assignment takes place, e.g. block/category.

assignment_probability.description: Reported probabilities, strata, and variation across units.

assignment_category.description: Reservation or treatment category, without inferred splitting.

identifying_assumption.description: Authors' assumption connecting comparison to causal claim.

compliance.description: Assignment versus receipt; first stage and noncompliance handling.

interference.description: Spillover/exposure mapping assumptions and relevant evidence.

attrition.description: Loss to follow-up by arm, denominators, timing, and handling.

preregistered_analysis.description: What was prespecified and how timing is established.

analysis_deviations.description: Reported departures from plan; do not infer undisclosed intent.

running_variable.description: RD running variable, scale, and threshold.

bandwidth.description: RD bandwidth, selection method, kernel and polynomial order.

instrument.description: IV instrument and authors' relevance/exclusion arguments.

treatment_timing.description: Timing/cohorts, anticipation and comparison periods for DiD.

sampling_method.description: Sampling frame, selection and representativeness claims.

n_observations.description: Observation count in this exact sample.

n_units.description: Distinct substantive units; not automatically independent.

n_treated.description: Treated units in the stated denominator.

n_control.description: Control units in the stated denominator.

exclusions.description: Eligibility and analysis exclusions with timing and reasons.

weights.description: Sampling/analysis weights and their target population.

overlap.description: Shared people, sites, controls, or data with other records/studies.

construct.description: Concept intended to be measured; separate from operational measure.

definition.description: Exact operational definition, question wording or coding rules.

family.description: Outcome family; analyst harmonization is a reviewer judgment.

data_source.description: Survey, administrative record, audit, media coding, etc.

instrument.description: Question, scale, coder procedure or measurement instrument.

units.description: Units and scale: counts, proportions, percent, pp, logs, etc.

direction.description: Meaning of larger values, without changing the reported sign.

timepoint.description: Measurement period or follow-up after treatment.

numerator.description: Who/what is counted in a share; event/person/story distinction.

denominator.description: Exact eligible population, including treatment of unknown categories.

missing_handling.description: Unknown race, missing outcomes, imputation and exclusions.

reliability.description: Coder agreement or measurement reliability, sample and metric.

outcome.description: Outcome label for this estimate, preserving subgroup and scale.

population.description: Exact sample/subgroup for the reported quantity.

contrast.description: Treatment minus control or other orientation; descriptive if no contrast.

timepoint.description: Outcome measurement time for this estimate.

specification.description: Model, table column, estimator, adjustments and sample restrictions.

measure.description: Coefficient, mean difference, proportion, RR, OR, log OR, etc.

value.description: Signed estimate in the paper's units; never harmonize silently.

units.description: Exact reported units, retaining percent versus percentage points.

standard_error.description: SE, not SD or interval width; no inference from stars.

standard_deviation.description: SD of the variable, distinct from uncertainty of the estimate.

interval_lower.description: Reported lower endpoint on the stated scale.

interval_upper.description: Reported upper endpoint on the stated scale.

interval_level.description: Coverage/credibility level as a fraction, e.g. 0.95.

p_value.description: Preserve inequalities and rounding, e.g. <0.001 or 0.000.

test_statistic.description: Reported t/z/F/chi-square statistic; type belongs in test_type.

test_type.description: Test/statistic type, null, sidedness and reference distribution.

degrees_of_freedom.description: Reported df; never replace with N or cluster count.

n_observations.description: Exact estimation sample, not full-study N.

n_clusters.description: Exact cluster count for this estimate.

cluster_unit.description: Clustering unit(s), separate from assignment unit.

control_mean.description: Control mean for the same sample/outcome/time.

control_sd.description: Control SD for the same sample/outcome/time.

preferred.description: Authors explicitly designate this specification preferred.

dependence_group.description: Shared sample/control/outcome dependence; judgment when inferred.

diagnostic_type.description: Balance, reconstruction, transitions, density, pretrends, etc.

procedure.description: Test actually performed, separate from recommended tests.

sample.description: Diagnostic sample, period, groups and geographic resolution.

null_hypothesis.description: Null actually tested; not every check has a statistical null.

scope_limit.description: What the test does not address; mark reviewer judgments.

replication_status.description: Located, source-rechecked or reproduced; evidence for status.

text.description: Authors' claim in context, including qualifications.

claim_type.description: Finding, mechanism, identifying premise, normative or contextual.

mechanism.description: Proposed mechanism; distinguish a label from its empirical test.

evidence_status.description: Asserted, speculated, tested, or mixed; give the coding rationale.

stance.description: Normative stance when authors state one, not the reviewer's preference.

scope.description: Population, place, period, office/category and applicable conditions.

support.description: Own test, theoretical argument, legal rule or prior-study citation.

qualification.description: Limits and counterevidence stated alongside the claim.

quantity.description: What is compared, e.g. Black perpetrator share.

observed_value.description: Reported study value in stated units.

benchmark_value.description: Reported comparison value in stated units.

units.description: Units of both values; mismatch must remain explicit.

benchmark_source.description: Arrests, victimization, population or other comparison source.

observed_denominator.description: Denominator and missing-category handling for observed value.

benchmark_denominator.description: Benchmark denominator; arrests are not all offending.

observed_scope.description: Observed geography, time, crime types and population.

benchmark_scope.description: Benchmark geography, time, crime types and population.

comparability.description: Authors' qualification or explicitly labeled reviewer assessment.
